title: HTML and JavaScript Integration
description: Learn how to integrate JavaScript with HTML to make web pages interactive.

lessons.title: Introduction to JavaScript in HTML
lessons.content: JavaScript can be embedded directly in HTML using the <script> tag, allowing dynamic content and interactive behavior on web pages.

lessons.title: Using the <script> Tag
lessons.content:
<!-- Inline JavaScript example -->
<script>
  alert('Hello from JavaScript!');
</script>

lessons.title: External JavaScript Files
lessons.content:
<!-- Linking an external JavaScript file -->
<script src="script.js"></script>

lessons.title: JavaScript Event Attributes
lessons.content: HTML elements can use event attributes like onclick, onmouseover, oninput to trigger JavaScript functions when user interacts.

lessons.title: Manipulating HTML Elements with JavaScript
lessons.content: Original Text

lessons.title: JavaScript and the DOM
lessons.content: The Document Object Model (DOM) represents the HTML document as nodes and objects, which JavaScript can manipulate to change page content, style, and structure.

lessons.title: Listening for Events in JavaScript
lessons.content:
<!-- Add event listener -->
<button id="btn">Click Me</button>
<script>
  document.getElementById('btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    alert('Button clicked via event listener!');
  });
</script>

lessons.title: JavaScript Timing Events
lessons.content: Use setTimeout and setInterval to run JavaScript code after a delay or repeatedly at intervals, enabling animations and timed updates.

lessons.title: Best Practices for Integrating JavaScript and HTML
lessons.content: Keep JavaScript separate from HTML when possible, use unobtrusive event handling, and ensure scripts load efficiently to maintain performance.
